c74object.name: touch.statusmanager
c74object.digest: Master rig controller, tablet inspector, set bank manager, and snapshot palette coordinator
c74object.description: Master orchestration interface and rig-wide snapshot coordinator for the Touch JSUI Suite in Cycling '74 Max 9 (v8ui / jsui). Discovers, monitors, and controls all active touch.status client modules across a shared zero-configuration wireless memory bus (Global("touch_status_bus")). Features an interactive tablet-ready touch chassis, multi-page Set Bank browser, rig-wide Snapshot Palette Deck with instant capture/morphing, slide-out module selection drawer, floating 50/50 Attrui parameter inspector with live morphable preview strip, and HSV color picker.

inlet.digest: Active module recall, morph, palette recall, set bank selection, or control messages
inlet.description: Accepts integers (recalls 1-based slot index on active module), floating-point numbers (continuous spatial morphing on active module), palette commands (palette, pal), set selection (set), bank paging (page, next_page, prev_page), module targeting (module, target, next, prev), state snapshot triggers (capture), rig scanning (resync, scan), window toggles (popup, bank, browse), and configuration attributes.

outlet.digest: Active Module / Set Bank / Palette name
outlet.description: Outputs the identifier string of the currently focused module, recalled Set Bank name, or active Palette snapshot. Connects to UI labels, text displays, or routing matrices.

outlet.digest: Status index / morph float / Palette index
outlet.description: Outputs the 1-based slot recall index or continuous float morph position of the active module, or the 1-based index / continuous fractional morph position of recalled snapshot palettes.

method.name: int
method.description: Triggers a 1-based preset recall on the currently selected module and outputs module name from Outlet 0 and slot number from Outlet 1.

method.name: float
method.description: Interpolates the active module across its slot layout using continuous floating-point morphing values (from 1.0 to N).

method.name: module / target
method.description: Focuses a specific client module either by 1-based discovered index or by unique symbol name (e.g. module 1 or module "Filter Rig").

method.name: next / prev
method.description: Steps the active module focus forward or backward through the discovered client table.

method.name: palette / pal
method.description: Recalls or interpolates rig-wide snapshot palettes within the current Set. Passing an integer recalls that palette snapshot across all mapped modules; passing a float continuously morphs all participating modules between adjacent palettes.

method.name: capture
method.description: Snapshots the current active slot configuration of every discovered client module and saves it into the specified 1-based palette index of the active Set.

method.name: set
method.description: Recalls a Set from the set bank by 1-based index or by exact name string, and opens its corresponding Palette Deck window.

method.name: page
method.description: Switches the Set Bank browser view to the specified 1-based page number.

method.name: next_page / prev_page
method.description: Navigates forward or backward through the Set Bank browser pages.

method.name: resync / scan
method.description: Flushes the internal client table and broadcasts a ping signal to all touch.status instances across the wireless status bus, re-establishing two-way bidirectional binding with all active patcher modules. Also accepts aliases clear and flush.

method.name: bank
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating paged Set Bank browser window.

method.name: browse
method.description: Opens the floating Quick-Picker Drawer displaying all discovered modules and their currently active preset slot tags.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating Master Status Inspector window containing the live interactive preview chassis and 50/50 attribute parameter rows.

method.name: refresh / bang
method.description: Triggers an immediate redraw of the main canvas and all open floating sub-windows.

attribute.name: sets_per_page
attribute.description: Number of Set Bank cards displayed per page in the floating Set Bank browser window (clamped between 2 and 20, default 5).

attribute.name: hold_threshold
attribute.description: Duration in milliseconds required to hold down on the module selector capsule before the floating Quick-Picker Drawer automatically opens (clamped between 150 ms and 1000 ms, default 350 ms).

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Base typography point size for slot numbers and preset names inside active grid cells (default 11 pt).

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Corner curvature radius in pixels of the chassis body and reticle arc corners.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke width in pixels of the outer corner reticle brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the corner bracket arms extending along chassis edges.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA fill color of the main chassis background.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA stroke color of outer reticle corner brackets, section dividers, and inactive cell borders.

attribute.name: highlight_color
attribute.description: RGBA accent color used for active slot fills, morph transitions, focus indicators, and navigation markers.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA color for slot labels, button titles, and module names.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the signature red inspector launcher dot in the upper-right corner.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables or disables the red inspector launcher dot and ctrl-click access to the floating Master Status Inspector.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: Toggles between the clean mini tablet preview mode and full 50/50 Attrui parameter rows inside the inspector window.

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Controls visibility of Sets Per Page, Hold Time, and Font Size controls inside the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Controls visibility of Border Radius, Border Thickness, and Border Extension sliders inside the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Controls visibility of Chassis Background, Border, Highlight, Text, and Popup Dot color rows inside the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Controls visibility of Inspector UI Theme Palette color rows (Popup BG, Attr BG, Attr Border, Attr Slider, Attr Text) inside the inspector.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: Base background fill color for all floating sub-windows (Master Inspector, Set Bank, Palette Deck, Quick-Picker).

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: Background fill color for individual attribute rows and sub-window cards.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: Stroke color for attribute row dividers and sub-window item outlines.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: Fill color for active slider gauges inside inspector parameter rows.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: Font color for parameter titles, numerical readouts, and sub-window tags.
